reference.code: pub fn ascii_query_escape(input:&str)->Option<String>{let mut o=String::new();for c in input.bytes(){if !(32..=126).contains(&c){return None}if c.is_ascii_alphanumeric()||b"-._~".contains(&c){o.push(c as char)}else{o.push_str(&format!("%{:02X}",c))}}Some(o)}
